NEW EVENTS - ISLAND TRADERS (TRD-01..13, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
A trader's canoe comes ashore with something to offer and something to ask for. Trade, haggle (it may go better or worse), or send the trader on with thanks.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A shell collector has the piece the village is missing, and asks for food.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A cheerful man named Kaia arrives with strings of shells, pebbles and dried beetle wings rattling from his belt. Kaia collects the island's small wonders and trades them from canoe to canoe. He has one piece the village is still missing, and he asks for food for it. (name1) turns the piece over in (his/her) hands and has to decide.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) brings the baskets, and Kaia ties the piece into (his/her) palm with a little bow. The children crowd around to see it set in its place with the others.

o3.name: Outcome C
o3.text: (name1) tells Kaia the village will find its own pieces in time. Kaia grins and says he hopes they do, and that he will come looking for theirs one day.

o2.name: Haggle, the better deal
o2.text: (name1) and Kaia talk so long about shells and beetles that they become friends, and Kaia lets the piece go for less, along with a story of where he found it.

o2b.name: Haggle, the worse deal
o2b.text: (name1) haggles, and Kaia, who has heard every trick, simply raises his price and waits. (name1) pays it, slightly embarrassed.

nothing.name: Nothing to trade
nothing.text: Kaia sees the village has little to spare, shows the children his whole collection for free, and paddles on.
